# bugs #2287: mcs51 --stack-auto: missing stores to a global in static inline functions that read a va_list

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/2287/
- Category: [Not reproducible](../../not-reproducible.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17158
- Recommended action: Remove the mcs51 condition in gcc-torture-execute-stdarg-5.c.in, run the test, and close the ticket if it passes.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The symptom of the ticket is absent from the code that r17158 generates. The run-time check of the
case is still disabled in the regression suite, so the case was compiled and was not executed.

The attachment exists in trunk as `support/regression/tests/gcc-torture-execute-stdarg-5.c.in`,
which builds one case with `static inline` and one case without it. The regression suite compiled
both cases on r17158 for mcs51-small-stack-auto and mcs51-large-stack-auto. In the assembly of the
`static inline` case, `f2` contains the code of `f2i`, and the stores to `y` are present. With the
small model there is a store after each of the three statements. With the large model the value is
computed across the three statements and stored once after the third. The sixth and the eleventh
comment contain code from 2014 that lacks these stores.

The assertions of the `static inline` case were not executed. In `testTortureExecute` an `#elif`
removes them when `__SDCC_mcs51`, `__SDCC_STACK_AUTO`, and `INLINED_yes` are defined and
`__SDCC_USE_XSTACK` is not, which is the configuration of the ticket. The condition has this form
since r9288. The case without `static inline` passes its 12 assertions in both variants.

`gcc-torture-execute-stdarg-4.c` does not cover the report. r9052, the workaround for this bug,
removed `static inline` from its functions.

The revision after which the stores are present was not identified.
